Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, crew, prepare to set sail on the hunt of a lifetime! Ensign Isabella, raise the jib!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aye, aye, captain Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahoy, Ferb! Any sign of the great white whale?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys better not be talking about me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Boys, can't you wait until we get the boat in the water?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, it's not actually called a boat, darling, it's called a sloop. When we're at sea there's no right or left, only port and starboard.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So... which side has the restroom?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's not a restroom, it's-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's called the poopdeck.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well no, actually, it's called the head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? Cause poopdeck makes much more sense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, can we just get this over with? Jeremy's throwing a romantic summer soiree at sunset tonight. I'm kind of on a deadline here.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, darling, it's only gonna be a three-hour tour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A three-hour tour?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You can use the time to soak up some vitamin D.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace distracted - check! Kids with lifejackets!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Excellent! Family pet. Say, where's Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Perry stayed home. Baljeet's watching him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Baljeet, what'cha doin'?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am watching Perry the Platypus. I promised to not take my eyes out off him all day.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, this is lame.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He's a platypus, they do not do much.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Maybe he needs some motivation. (Swings a baseball bat)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, no please! I have given my solemn oath to protect the little monotreme until the Flynn family comes home.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Perry's wristwatch communicator starts beeping) What is that weird noise?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know, maybe a car alarm? (Perry stands up and puts the wristwatch communicator into his mouth)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, I think it stopped. (The wristwatch communicator is still beeping inside of Perry. Baljeet and Buford look at him)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My king-of-the-world bit. Hey, check that out! (Two dolphins jump, and it jumps again with Ferb, and jump again) And look at those cool flags.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: According to my Fireside Girls manual each one of those flags has a meaning. The blue flag means crab season and the yellow flag means hold the mustard, and that last one, I'm not sure what that one means.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, who turned off the sun?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, here it is. The red flag with the black box means... storm warning!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You kids get below! I'll head us back to shore! Wooah!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, we're heading towards that whirlpool.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Keep faith in me, my darling! I have everything under control!!!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on Perry's wristwatch communicator) Agent P, come in! Agent P? Blast it, Carl, why doesn't he answer?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think it's comin' from his stomach. (He picks up Perry, and put onto his shoulder)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He must be hungry. I will get him something to eat.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't worry, little ducky thing, we're gonna take good care of you. (Perry then sticks his tongue out with the wristwatch communicator on it)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is everything all right, Agent P? I'm sensing you're in a bit of a jam. Can you get us a better view of the situation?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna hug you and squeeze you and never let you go.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Looks like we picked a bad day to send all of our field agents to sensitivity training. We're all out of options. (gasps) I was hoping this day would never come, but, Carl, this is your big chance! (Carl gets raised up on a chair as he salutes him.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ugh, I think it's finally clearing up.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, the ship held together pretty good, didn't it? (shift to reveal he's holding the wheel surrounded by debris from the wreckage.) Of course, we'll have to re-attach the wheel (shift to reveal the sloop on a rock.) and fix that, uh, giant hole. Now, kids, are you all right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're fine!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you okay? (He sees what looks like Ferb's legs. He lifts them up to reveal they are only his pants. Ferb, covering his birthday suit with a giant leaf, walks over to get them.) Oh, there you are. And there's Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cut to reveal her with a giant barrel on her head. She pulls it off to reveal a squid on her face.) Hey, what gives?! (She pulls the squid off to reveal a fish in her mouth and lobsters on her ears. She pulls the lobsters off and spits out the fish.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (inspecting the hole) Whoa, this doesn't look too good at all. Kids, don't come up here! It's far too dangerous! Mum and I will fix the boat. Candace, why don't you look for some food? And, boys, you could find us some shelter if you like. We may be here for a while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A while? You mean we're stranded? That means I won't get to Jeremy's party before the sun sets! We'll be stuck here forever eating rocks and bugs, then I'll have to marry a monkey and have monkey kids and name them Xavier and Amanda! (sobs)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And we'll love them anyway. Candace, the sooner we get started, the sooner we all get to go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Stay safe, everyone! (Linda waves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shelter....shelter.... Well, this spot has potential.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great, let's get started!

Name: Montage
Dialog: The gang map out the shelter and get started working on it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor in the ice cream truck) Remember, Carl, nothing distracts kids like ice cream. You need to get rid of those two boys so Agent P can proceed with his mission.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (salutes) Aye aye, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Both hands on the wheel, Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Perry, I could not find the platypus food.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, boy!

Name: Baljeet and Buford
Dialog: (running off) Ice cream! Ice cream!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Perry puts on his fedora. But then puts it in his mouth when he returns.) Oh, I almost forgot Perry. Come along. Let us get you a little treat. (he grabs the platypus, who holds onto the grass.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gimme a double caramel fudge.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ugh! Hey, this is butterscotch ripple! (A small door slides up on the truck with a lit arrow. Perry spits out his fedora, puts it on and zips into it.) Is this your first day on the job or somethin'?! (The truck speeds out.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, he didn't charge me! Rookie mistake.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did not even get to—Wait?! Where is Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Glad to have you back, Agent P. You lost some time, but I brought along the escape cone. (Cut to the roof of the truck. The strawberry ice cream on top launches revealing a cone under it with Agent P riding it. When it becomes airborne, wings pop out of it. A monitor appears on the cherry.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor) Agent P, we've just received reports that Doofenshmirtz has been buying up all the laundry detergent in the Tri-State Area. We want you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. You'll need to use your tracking device to find him before your delicious ice cream cone melts. (Perry salutes. An island appears on the screen. Perry lands on the island.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (shift downward to her, wandering around; imitating her father) "Oh, Candace, go find us some food." Yeah, like a quart of ice cream is just gonna fall out of the— (The strawberry ice cream from the escape cone lands on her head.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, where is Perry the Platypus? He should have been here hours ago. (Perry approaches him) Ah, Perry the Platypus. Well, y'know, I had a trap for you, but no time. (Grabs him and runs off) This one's a little complicated, okay? (He puts Perry in a chair in front of a screen.) You remember a few schemes ago when I couldn't figure out what "Big Laundry" meant? (A slide of Doofenshmirtz from "The Lake Nose Monster" appears on the screen.) Well, this! (Another slide appears) This is what I meant! I am nefariously planning to provide the entire population of the Tri-State Area with free laundry, (change slide) which will drive out of business all of the local laundromats, (change slide) freeing up prime real estate locations (change slide) for my newest franchise

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Perry! Where are you?! Oh, it is no use. I fear he is gone for good.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why don't you just buy him a new one? They won't know the difference.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot just buy a—Wait. That gives me an idea!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (collecting coconuts) We don't need to eat. We need to get out of here! (tries to get a coconut off a tree) I swear, if I don't get to Jeremy's party— (A monkey appears from behind the bushes and kisses her) Yuck! Monkey cooties! (The monkey grabs her, leading up a ladder of monkeys and flings her into a hut.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what do you think of our shelter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dusts herself off and shouts in her brother's face) Can't you just be normal for one day?!? All you had to do was make a little lean-to for survival.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, there's survival and then there's living. (Zoom out to reveal the entirety of the shelter. He pushes Candace inside.) Let us give ya a quick tour. We've got everything we need to make our maritime mishap as enjoyable as possible. Here's our warm and cozy family room, a fully-stocked kitchen. We even have indoor plumbing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cut to Ferb doing something familiar.) You're giving a monkey a shower?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yep, had to be done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grrrr! Don't you realize I have a very important party to go to?! If you're going to all this trouble, you could have built us a bridge back to town!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Dad didn't ask us to build a bridge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or you could have built us a coconut-powered hovercraft!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Dad didn't ask us to build—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or-Or you could have made a gigantic slingshot and shot us back to the mainland!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, not bad. (Ferb makes a note of it) Mind if we use that someday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (leaves) Oooh, you two are gonna be so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. No, Candace! Not that way! That's the— (Candace opens a door that leads to nothing and falls) emergency exit. (shift to Candace landing in the mud.) I was trying to tell you, it's not done yet. There's gonna be this whole slide thing that dumps you into the hot tub! We're waiting on some parts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, Perry the Platypus! (Cut to reveal Perry raveling up a towel.) Will you put that down right— (He smacks him with it) Ow! Ow, Oh that smarts! (Doofenshmirtz throws his shoe at Perry. Perry jumps as the shoe misses and hits the Monkey Enslave-inator off of the monkey. The monkeys all look angrily at Doofenshmirtz.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Candace, do you want a banana smoothie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got you guys this time! There's no way you could dismantle your stupid tropical dream house before I drag Mom back here to bust you! (She walks out.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So... no smoothie then?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Ow! Oh! Ow! (Doofenshmirtz comes out of the laundry basket dressed as a bride to Perry's groom. Perry lets him have it, but then jumps away.) That's right, run away, Perry the Pla—aaaaaahhh!! (Doofenshmirtz falls into the giant washing machine. A bunch of monkeys on one side drop clothes into the machine.) Nice try, Perry the Plat— (Another group of monkeys drop in detergent.) Wai-wai-wait, what are you doing? Don't throw the bright colors in with the—Hey that's too much soap! (bulbs as the monkeys push the start button) Curse you, Perry the Pla—I told you no starch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Volcano!! (slides down a palm tree) We need to move now! (She grabs Phineas and Ferb as the bubbles take the shelter away with it.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait until Mom and Dad find out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run, Candace! Pink lava behind you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pink lava? (she screams and runs away as the "pink lava" chases after them, while Perry still surfs on it. Cut to Lawrence repairing the sloop.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, that's it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great job fixing the ship, honey. (Cut to reveal the sloop is still on the rock.) But how are we going to get it back in the water?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, well, um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, we gotta get outta here!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Woo! Hurry up, kids! Women and children first! (Isabella, Phineas, Ferb, Candace and Linda walk up the ladder into the ship followed by him. The pink lava pushes the ship off the rock and back into shore.)  Kids, we're headed home!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You were magnificent, captain!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Can't we go any faster! Come on, steer this thing! Go go go go go go!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Buford. (Buford gives Baljeet a tennis ball and a black marker.) Perhaps this will buy us a little time. Frozen waffle, please. (Buford gives him a frozen waffle with a bite mark out of it.) Ugh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry. Got hungry.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ugh. Maybe they will not know the difference. (Cut to reveal a hastily made platypus with a pool 2-ball and the tennis ball for eyes, a baseball cap for the head and bill, a sack of flour for the body, and the frozen waffle for the tail.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think it's pretty convincing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, who am I kidding?! We will have to tell them the truth!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (runs off) You're on your own, Jeet! I'm outta here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Car horn honks.) Hey, Baljeet, we're home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cut to the car with the sloop attached to it. As soon as it stops, she bullets her way out.) Hold on, Jeremy! I'm coming!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my friends! (sobs) I hope you can forgive me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet, wait till you hear what we did today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But I have something to tell you first!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is— (Perry walks in and chatters.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! Aw, and look at that! (Perry approaches the fake platypus) Baljeet made Perry a little friend. Thanks, Baljeet. I knew we could count on you. (Baljeet faints; Perry looks at his "new friend" and growls angrily. Cue iris out.)
